description: The standard `import`/`export` syntax. Static, supports top-level `await`, requires file extensions in relative imports in Node.
Node's original module system: `require()` and `module.exports`. Dynamic and synchronous; still common in older packages.
One `export default` per module, imported under any name; many named exports, imported by their exact name with `{ }`.
`package.json` field that makes `.js`/`.ts` files ESM. Without it they are CommonJS (or detected). `.mjs`/`.cjs` force one system.
`package.json` field listing a package's public entry points. Unlisted files cannot be imported (`ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED`).
`import fs from 'node:fs'` marks a built-in explicitly so an npm package with the same name can never shadow it.
A module that re-exports other modules' exports (`export { x } from './x.ts'`) to define one public surface.
